name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 15 Tracking and Reporting Progress
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
How to track KPIs and turn them into a client report that tells a story. (There is no Module 14 in the saved PDFs.)

# KPIs
Organic traffic, local rankings, GBP insights (calls, direction requests, views), conversions, review count and rating, backlink and citation counts.

# Practices
- Log metrics monthly in a sheet or dashboard; record the baseline at the start.
- Note the date of every major change so improvements can be tied to it.
- Compare year over year; do not overreact to one week.
- Reports should narrate cause and effect ("moved from #5 to #3 for [service] in [city], calls up from 20 to 30") and list work completed.
- Use the data to find stalled keywords and weak calls-to-action.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Mirrors the [Client Report Dashboard](lib:brain-client-report-dashboard) (month over month, results first, work log) and the Updates tab in the [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker).
- TAG report rules: missing data shows "Not available", never 0; no prices or phone numbers in reports.
